currentParagraphText: “Alright... let’s start simple with a quickdraw,” Artemis said as she lifted her bow, knocked an arrow, and loosed the string in one fluid, quick motion.

finalResult.currentParagraphText: “Alright... let’s start simple with a quickdraw,” Artemis said as she lifted her bow, knocked an arrow, and loosed the string in one fluid, quick motion.
finalResult.nextParagraphText: Before the arrow was even released, Jake’s danger senses screamed at him as he dodged to the side, right as an arrow flew by him, the second Artemis had let go of the string.
finalResult.previousParagraphText: “No worries,” Jake assured her. He remained confident and was ready for her to take the first shot.
